source_findings.finding: PMC6897412 Table 2 summaries use survey weights and their intervals describe estimate uncertainty. The methods explicitly state that sampling weights were not applied to the stratum/age/sex-adjusted regressions. The selected Table 4 HDL contrasts are categorical, not continuous per-unit BMI slopes.

PMC6897412 Table 4 reports female HDL coefficient +0.08 mmol/L with 95% CI [0.05,0.11], whereas the narrative describes lower HDL for females. The candidate retains this inconsistency as contextual evidence and does not use it as a sex coefficient.

For Table 4 age contrasts, stratum and sex are established minimum adjustments; the complete reported age-row model adjustment is not fully explicit. Current applicability text now says known minimum adjustment and full adjustment unresolved. The corresponding v1 checks remain unsupported.

PMC6897412 lipid samples were nonfasting serum measured by Cobas Integra 400 Plus. PMC4457529 describes 12-14-hour fasting serum lipid assays and health-selection exclusions. Neither establishes equivalence to target venous-EDTA CardioChek measurement.

working_law_check.scope: Deterministic bookkeeping from source statistics under declared mathematical assumptions; no generator execution, simulation, observed target quantity, or independent clinical support.

remaining_assumptions: Source-to-target population, health-selection and assay transfer remains unverified; no source population is reconstructed.
Greiner weighting and quantile convention, Navrongo weighting/SD convention, and Ashanti weighting/ties/pair-specific missingness remain unestablished.
New-paper categorical designs require source strata and other adjustment variables absent from the delivered task. The age-row full adjustment set remains unresolved.
Demographic mixture, bounded/interpolated age law, within-category shapes, age-BMI dependence and cross-source combination are author scenarios.

Marginal rank associations and individual CVs are transferred into conditional lipid terms/residuals under explicit working-law assumptions. Reusing total CVs conditionally can increase total variation.
Reported source CI widths do not identify individual residual variation; no CI-derived SD or hidden-target fit was identified.
Source-n metadata is not established for each selected analysis row; group counts must not be substituted for regression/pair-specific n.
Matching a source number or derived algebra does not establish usefulness, clinical prediction, causal interpretation, or inferential precision.
